hotspots.title: Poland's false alarm raids spark political firestorm
hotspots.blurb: Poland's government faces intense backlash after emergency services forcibly entered the homes of President Nawrocki's family and other right-wing figures following false alarms. Opposition leader Jarosław Kaczyński accuses the ruling party of orchestrating a political provocation.
hotspots.affect: This controversy commands disproportionate attention due to its high moral charge and polarized contention, with accusations of state-sanctioned intimidation against political opponents.
